Had given the vehicle to service and few repairs in month of August. However on receipt lots of issues  cropped up. Auto lock, stereo system, door light Indicator not operational. Strictly no go in future.

Proactive Care: While checking a minor AC issue, Rahul’s incredible attention to detail led him to discover an engine oil leak that the official service center had completely ignored.
Transparency & Evidence: Rahul didn't just tell me the official service was botched; he proved it. He opened the Throttle Body right in front of me to show it was still choked with carbon deposits, despite Hyundai claiming they had serviced it.
Genuine Workmanship: Unlike the official center, Rahul provided video evidence of every part he worked on, ensuring I knew exactly what was being done.
Value for Money: The quality of work at The Car Garage was miles ahead of the official center, yet the charges were significantly more affordable
